summary: Nightly audit — 7 new findings (6 IMPORTANT + 4 COSMETIC). 6 findings fixed in this run. 2 require human review (AUDIT-factory-a5d3e092 security policy change, AUDIT-factory-71c4b389 sprint creation).

findings.title: AGENTS.md §13 claims a git pre-push hook that does not exist
findings.fix: Updated §13 to accurately describe the force-push blocker as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json, not a git pre-push hook. Added note that non-Claude terminal pushes are unprotected and .husky/pre-push would close the gap.

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md §5 invariant 1 'Markdown only' is now false
findings.fix: Updated invariant 1 to say 'no application code' and explicitly acknowledge that enforcement tooling (.husky/, .github/, .claude/) is present but contains only hooks and configuration.

findings.title: ADR-0001 cited as rationale for the no-.yaml-siblings rule, but ADR-0001 does not discuss this
findings.fix: Replaced the 'ADR-0001' citation with accurate parenthetical in both files: ADR-0001 covers the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md bridge; the YAML rationale is in ARCHITECTURE.md §5 and AGENTS.md §7.

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md §6 cross-cutting table lists wrong owner for Logging standard
findings.fix: Changed Logging Owner from 'AGENTS.md §6' to 'ARCHITECTURE.md §6' — the standard is defined in §6 of ARCHITECTURE.md itself, not in AGENTS.md.

findings.title: SECURITY.md Protected Paths canonical list is missing **/(auth)/** which is enforced in CODEOWNERS and protected-paths.yml
findings.description: The **/(auth)/** glob (Next.js route-group auth pattern) is enforced in .github/CODEOWNERS and .github/workflows/protected-paths.yml but absent from SECURITY.md's canonical Protected Paths list. Adding it is a security-tightening change; removing from CODEOWNERS/workflow would be a security regression. Requires operator review to confirm the intent and update SECURITY.md.

findings.title: No active sprint document — SPRINT.md only contains a reconciled incomplete sprint
findings.description: SPRINT-2026-05-B was never created. Agents following AGENTS.md §2 required reading arrive at SPRINT.md expecting an active work queue and find only a completed/deferred sprint. Requires Sebastian to create SPRINT-2026-05-B or explicitly mark the current work queue.

findings.title: AGENTS.md §3 repo structure tree is outdated — ADR range and enforcement dirs missing
findings.fix: Updated ADR range from 0001-0010 to 0001-0011 and added .husky/, .github/, and .claude/ directories to the tree.

findings.title: ROADMAP.md M-005 adrs field references superseded ADR-0006
findings.fix: Changed M-005 adrs: [ADR-0006] to adrs: [ADR-0011] (ADR-0011 supersedes ADR-0006 on the Retell voice platform choice, accepted 2026-06-04).

findings.title: ARCHITECTURE.md related_adrs frontmatter does not include ADR-0011
findings.fix: Added ADR-0011 to the related_adrs frontmatter list.

findings.title: SECURITY.md last_verified date is 38+ days stale
findings.fix: Updated Last verified date to 2026-07-04. Added note about the AUDIT-factory-a5d3e092 gap that still needs operator review.
